_comment: Japan Badminton Court — real customer tenant for the demo.
Coordinates and Place IDs are the venues' real Google Maps values.
timezone is deliberately UTC, not Asia/Kolkata: see F-100. Setting a real zone activates
F-087 (availability-window creation parses naive datetimes against the server clock while
judging boundaries against the branch clock). Correct it as part of F-087/F-088, not here.
themeColor is JBC's real brand green (#166534), not the earlier #c8102e placeholder, and logo
points at the 512x512 PNG served from the guest PWA's public/ directory. Both live here as well
as in the database because provisioning only sends this block on CREATE - an existing tenant is
reused untouched - so a config left stale would silently restore the placeholder the next time
the tenant is rebuilt after a wipe. Same reasoning as the minOccupancy note below.
minOccupancy is deliberately 1, not 2: see F-125. Co-player collection was removed from the
guest booking UI for the MVP, so every guest booking sends groupSize 1 with no UI path to
raise it. With minOccupancy 2 the server rejected every guest booking with 400
INVALID_GROUP_SIZE. Do NOT raise this back to 2 until F-114's per-pool enforceMinOccupancy
toggle exists, or until co-players return to the booking UI.
